codex_gold_comparison.basis: historical spot bid/ask quotes with Codex's fee/slip assumptions; not broker fills, not a US-instrument result, private data not used or published here
codex_gold_comparison.notes: 627 modeled fills; worst basket mark -$8.93; max net notional $13,587.32; with $10k and 100% collateral, short of capital on 3 entry days
codex_gold_comparison.what: Codex private 2023 XAUUSD spot replay of the Reddit gold basket (escalating legs, +$3/-$6)

data.source: synthetic SYNTH-FUND-60M; not evidence about gold or any market

declaration.metric: mean daily net USD after costs, every session counted, $0 sessions included
declaration.pass_criterion: mean > 0 overall and in F1, F2, F3; holdout mean > 0; bootstrap p05 > 0; costs x2 mean > 0. Otherwise 'does not beat cash'.
declaration.path_checks: every start session of normal_bars, worst intrabar marks, $10,000 research reference balance (assumption, not Matthew's limit); margin breach = gross > 2x equity or equity < 25% of gross; barriers -6% / +10%
declaration.test_size: tvbot/config/smaller_size.json order_notional, TEST VALUES, never tuned
declaration.untouched_final_period: holdout_bars.jsonl (30 sessions), claimed once with the rule hash
declaration.walk_forward: rules frozen, no refit: chronological evaluation windows F1=sessions 1-30, F2=31-60, F3=61-90 of normal_bars

holdout_claim.note: holdout_bars.jsonl first evaluated by worker C strategies with these rules. A changed rule hash refuses the holdout. EMAX's holdout was already claimed 2026-11-14T22:17:06Z, so the ema rows are not a first look.
